name: DE-JA
source:
The name of this game's hero is Ryuusuke; he has a fascination for ancient civilizations and archeology, researching them thoroughly in hope of finding legendary treasure. One day he has a strange dream after having dozed off in his office: he has found an enormous mythical treasure, which is guarded by a terrifying monster... when he wakes up, he is contacted by an old man, who wants Ryuusuke to reveal the truth about a mysterious ancient staff.
And then strange things begin to happen...

[Edited from [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/deja]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
本作主人公名叫龙介。他对古代文明与考古学深感着迷，为了找到传说中的宝藏而潜心研究。一天，他在办公室打盹后做了一个奇怪的梦：自己发现了一件巨大的神话宝藏，却有一头可怕的怪物守护在那里…醒来后，一名老人联系了龙介，希望他揭开一根神秘古代手杖背后的真相。
随后，怪事开始接连发生…

[编辑自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/deja]Moby Games[/url]]
